what: Coverage before and after representative data entry, measured in a throwaway test database seeded with the campus catalogue (CampusCatalogSeeder) plus the one food venue. Entered values were fictitious (example.edu, +90 000 ...) and exist only in that throwaway database; no local or production record was changed. The throwaway database has no crawled pages, so academic dates and programme rows read as source-unavailable there; the local database (docs/coverage/phase4a_baseline.json) has them.
entered: food venue: campus place + Mon-Fri weekly hours
every club: Instagram URL, e-mail, room
